tools.name: calculate_net_salary
tools.description:
Computes net pay from gross pay for one pay period with the country's official payroll algorithm.
Returns every employee deduction and employer contribution as a line with the rule applied and its source,
the employer's total cost, annualised figures and the assumptions made.

tools.name: calculate_gross_salary
tools.description:
Finds the smallest gross pay (to the cent) whose net pay reaches the target, by bisection over the same engine
as /net. Returns the full breakdown for that gross pay and the remaining difference to the target.

tools.name: compare_net_salaries
tools.description:
Runs up to 8 gross-to-net scenarios and returns them side by side: net, deductions, employer cost and the
split into income tax and social contributions. Amounts stay in each country's currency (no FX conversion).

tools.name: get_payroll_parameters
tools.description:
Allowances, tax bands, contribution rates and ceilings the engine uses for the country and year, each with
its official source.

tools.name: list_salary_countries
tools.description:
Coverage: which countries and tax years are available, which pay periods and profile fields they accept, the
official test data each engine is checked against, and which countries are planned next.
